_comment: VPIN (Volume-Synchronized Probability of Informed Trading) configuration & thresholds based on Easley, Lopez de Prado, and O'Hara (2010, 2012).
_bucket_volume_note: Fixed volume V per bucket. For NIFTY futures contracts, 50000 is standard (approx ADV / 50).
_window_length_note: Rolling window length n (number of volume buckets) over which VPIN is computed.
_volatility_window_note: Number of consecutive time bars for rolling standard deviation of price changes (sigma_delta_s).
_buckets_per_day_note: Target number of volume buckets per trading session when auto-calculating bucket size from volume.
_toxicity_threshold_low_note: VPIN below this indicates balanced order flow, low toxicity, ideal for option selling (theta capture).
_toxicity_threshold_moderate_note: VPIN above this level indicates normal institutional flow activity.
_toxicity_threshold_high_note: VPIN above this level indicates high order flow toxicity and impending volatility expansion (option buying).
_toxicity_threshold_extreme_note: VPIN above this indicates extreme toxicity, market maker adverse selection stress, and flash crash risk.
_cdf_alert_percentile_note: CDF[VPIN] >= 0.90 flags top 10% historically toxic order flow.
_cdf_extreme_percentile_note: CDF[VPIN] >= 0.99 flags historical flash crash danger zone (Easley et al., 2010).
_directional_imbalance_threshold_note: Signed imbalance ratio threshold |VB - VS| / (n * V) to confirm strong directional momentum.
_rolling_cdf_window_note: Number of completed buckets used for rolling empirical CDF calculation.
